title: This Spot Gets Hit by Lightning Over 1.2 Million Times a Year

scenes.text: One spot on Earth gets struck by lightning over a million times a year.
It's in Venezuela, where the Catatumbo River meets a huge lake.
More than 1.2 million bolts hit that small area every year.
Guinness World Records says it has the highest concentration of lightning on Earth.
The storms flash night after night in the same place.
A storm that never really leaves.

description:
At the mouth of the Catatumbo River in Venezuela, over 1.2 million lightning bolts strike every year.
Guinness World Records recognizes it as the highest concentration of lightning on Earth.
Would you visit?
first_comment: 1.2 million lightning bolts a year in one place. Would you go and watch?
